message.content: I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password. If you’ve forgotten your password, the safest way to regain access is to reset it. You can usually do this by clicking “Forgot password?” on the login page and following the instructions sent to your email. Once you’ve reset it, let me know if you need help logging in again.
